mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the unemployment rate below 4.5% signals tightening labor market conditions, which increases corporate wage pressures and inflation expectations, leading to higher equity risk premiums and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE < 4.5%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate above 1.0% within a 3-month window signals the start of a monetary tightening cycle, which increases discount rates for equity valuations and reduces risk appetite, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over any 2-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in both residential investment (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) signals strong aggregate demand growth, which accelerates corporate earnings momentum and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS rise, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05) in a multivariate regression.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production below 104.0 over two consecutive months indicates weakening supply-side capacity utilization, which signals economic slowdown and reduced corporate profitability, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over any 3-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in housing starts above 1.2 million units per month, combined with rising consumer spending, signals a surge in private demand that boosts near-term corporate revenues and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where both HOUST > 1200 and RSAFS > 470000, or the interaction term is not significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent rise in payroll employment (PAYEMS) and a decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals strong labor market tightening, which increases inflationary pressures and prompts the Fed to raise rates, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases > 100k and UNRATE decreases > 0.2pp in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the joint signal fails to outperform a simple average of individual series (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A stable or declining CPI (CPIAUCSL) below 2.5% combined with a low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 1.2%) indicates persistent disinflationary pressures, which sustain low discount rates and support equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where both conditions hold, or the interaction effect is not significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption (RSAFS) above 470 billion dollars, combined with a rising GDP growth rate (GDPC1), signals strong aggregate demand momentum that drives corporate earnings growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where both conditions are met, or the interaction term is not significant (p > 0.05).
